sentences.text: 1. Brief facts of the case are that on 19-08-2017, at about 3:19 pm, an information was received at PS Sonia Vihar that at House no. 483, Gali no. 6, Ramnath School, Circular Road, near Transformer wife of brother of caller had committed suicide.

The information was reduced into writing vide 41B State vs Pratap Singh on 31 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99756338/
1 and the same was marked to ASI Mohan Lal, (hereinafter referred to as first IO/Investigating Officer).

Thereafter, IO along with HC Pramod Kumar visited the spot i.e. H. No. C-413, Gali no. 3,
Circular Road, near Ramnath Public School, 2nd Pusta, Sonia Vihar, Delhi where the dead body of a female was found lying in the gallery.
Upon inquiry, the name of the deceased was revealed as Neetu w/o Pratap Singh and that she was married in the year 2014.
The information was passed on to Senior police officials and SDM concerned.
The IO had also intimated the family members of the deceased.
The Crime Team was called which inspected the spot.
One steel glass containing some liquid covered with polythene and lying on the cooler, one piece of paper containing black colour substance were sealed and seized.
FSL team was also intimated.
However, due to heavy burden, the FSL team could not arrive.
The dead body was sent to mortuary of GTB hospital through HC Pratap.

On 20-08-2017, father of the deceased namely Sh. Diwan Singh Adhikari along with his son had been produced before the Executive Magistrate Sh. R. L. Meena, who recorded statement of father of deceased.
The father of deceased stated that he got his daughter Neetu married with Pratap Singh on 16-05-2014.
The matrimonial life of his daughter was in a very bad state.
He used to send sometimes Rs. 40,000, Rs, 8,000/-, Rs. 5,000/- and Rs. 2,000/- in the interval of six months, out of which, he had given Rs. 2,000/- in the month of July.
However, he did not remember the exact date.
He received the last call of his daughter on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan when his daughter reported to him that her in-laws and her husband would kill her at any time.
Thereafter, he did not speak with her daughter.
The deceased was having one daughter out of the wedlock, who was 2 years old.
He raised suspicion that her daughter might have been killed by her in-laws.
On 21-08-2017, the FSL team arrived at PS, which was taken to the spot.
The FSL team inspected the spot which was got preserved by the IO.
On the directions of FSL team, two steel glasses, two spoons and one plastic water bottle were sealed and seized.
On the basis of statement of father of deceased and prevailing circumstances, the present FIR came to be registered for the offence punishable u/s 498A/304B/34 of IPC.
Thereafter, further investigation was conducted by Inspector Subhash Kumar.
On 21-08-2017, postmortem of the deceased was got conducted.
The viscera of the deceased was collected from the mortuary and sent to FSL for analysis.
During investigation

,
Inspector Subhash Kumar had clicked photographs of the deceased as something was found written on the palm of deceased.
The mobile phone of Inspector Subhash Kumar was taken into police possession.

The husband of deceased namely Pratap Singh, brother in law Devender Singh, sister in law Deepa, and mother-in-law Bhagwati Devi were arrested.

17.7. The expression "soon before" is a relative term and it would depend upon circumstances of each case and no straitjacket formula can be laid down as to what would constitute a period of soon before the occurrence.
17.8. It would be hazardous to indicate any fixed period and that brings in the importance of a proximity test both for the proof of an offence of dowry death as well as for raising a presumption under Section 113-B of the Evidence Act.
17.9. Therefore, the expression "soon before" would normally imply that the interval should not be much between the cruelty or harassment concerned and the death in question.
There must be existence of a proximate or live link between the effect of cruelty based on dowry demand and the death concerned.
In other words, it should not be remote in point of time and thereby make it a stale one.
However, the expression "soon before" should not be given a narrow meaning which would otherwise defeat the very purpose of the provisions of the Act and should not lead to absurd results.
